CONFIDENCE: 97

Hana must be in slot 6. Slots 4, 5, 7 and 8 each lead to a contradiction, and slots 1–3 are impossible because Ben, Cara and Gus all have to come before Hana. With Hana in 6, Finn is in 7. Ann must be in 5 (exactly one person between Ann and Finn), and Cara and Gus must be in slots 1 and 4, which forces Ben into 2 and Elif into 3. Dev goes in 9 and Ivo in 8. I checked all 17 constraints against this order and each holds.

The team note is wrong. Hana is in slot 6 and Finn in slot 7, so neither is in the first half of the schedule.
